summary: Host repetition plus embedded PTX semantics identify no work-count omission. Each timed iteration launches the same complete SpMV with ceil(numRows/256) blocks of 256 threads and all CSR operands; final synchronization precedes end clock. Embedded actual PTX assigns one thread to each guarded row, reads its two CSR bounds, processes the remainder then four-at-a-time entries with double multiply-accumulates through the end bound, and writes even empty-row zero sums. Only sm52 cubins are present in existing dumps, not sm86-compatible native code: on the stated sm86 target successful normal loading therefore uses forward-compatible PTX JIT, not the inspected sm52 SASS. No final JIT SASS inspection is asserted.

adjudication_rationale: Luna's sm52-to-sm86 native compatibility inference was incorrect. NVIDIA documents native cubin compatibility only within a major capability revision, while PTX is forward-compatible and JIT used without compatible cubin. Correcting evidence level removes that unsupported SASS claim without turning legitimate PTX JIT into a scientific failure.
limitations: Verdict concerns source, bound host and embedded PTX work semantics, assuming conforming CUDA driver/JIT. No sm86 final JIT SASS/cache artifact was supplied or generated, so this is not final-machine-code verification on the target. JIT availability/driver PTX-version acceptance and actual runtime success are not established by this static review. Source uses 32-bit dimension multiplication and lacks general invalid-input checks; this is a separate input-domain concern, not evidence of omitted requested repetitions or nonzeros for the reviewed valid workload.

primary_reference.claim: Cubin compatibility does not cross compute-capability major versions; PTX is forward-compatible and runtime JIT generates target cubin when compatible native code is absent.

primary_quality_check.method: Read both complete Sol adjudications and verified primary NVIDIA library-contract and cubin/PTX compatibility documentation. Independently inspected Gemini complete relevant source/build, actual timed inline CUDA launch/count/sync host path and full embedded PTX through every remainder/chunk backedge and store; confirmed sm52-only headers. Inspected Terra full CSR distribution/rebase, descriptors and timed source plus actual external-call counter/event synchronization. Remaining host parsing/partition compiled details inspected by Sol. Accepted findings explicitly retain contract-level and PTX/JIT evidence limits, not native target SASS certification.
corrections: Expanded source references to full pinned files; preserved every Sol rationale, evidence limitation and primary reference.
